textSegments: Compliance with newest SFX12V V3.3 & ATX12V V2.4
High quality 80mm dual ball bearing fan
Advanced full modular design with ribbon cables
Full protections OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, OCP, OTP
The Dagger series is compatible with most Mini-ITX and Micro ATX small form factor PCs. It is ideal for the living room PCs, and an alternative option for gamers.

Dagger Series are 80 PLUS Gold certified power supply units that guarantee to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power which has lower running costs with less electrical waste.
By taking high efficient LLC topology, high level server grade PCB and DC to DC module design, Dagger series provides gamers with an ultimate entertainment experience.
By taking high efficient LLC topology, high level server grade PCB and DC to DC modules design, dagger series provides gamers with an ultimate entertainment experience.

Fully- modular and flat ribbon cables mean easy installation. Its parallel wires are a perfect solution for applications with limited space. This also enhances the overall airflow, makes the system cooler as less heat is trapped inside, and prolongs the product life span.

Fully- modular and flat ribbon cables mean easy installation. Its parallel wires are a perfect solution for applications with limited space. This also enhances the overall airflow, makes the system cooler as less heat is trapped inside, and prolongs the product life span.
Featured with high power density, 2 times higher than the ATX PSU in the same wattage.
Featured with high power density, 2 times higher than the ATX PSU in the same wattage.
105 °C Japanese-made Capacitor and Solid Capacitor, makes prolonged life span possible.
+12V SR circuit, combining both +3.3V and +5V DC-DC modules, offers supreme efficiency, voltage stability and high system compatibility especially in cross regulation (unbalanced load) mode.
Comparing traditional welding method, Dagger series take copper bar to connect mainboard and daughter board together so that to enhance conversion efficiency.
Like all FSP SFX PSU, Dagger series also equipped with a bracket for easy fitting into standard PS2 ATX case.
